note: RES-113 quality benchmark request set. Keep ids stable: summaries are compared by id across runs. Years are 5-10 because that is what the portal accepts. `checks` are extra things the grader must look at for that request; they never change the rubric.

requests.subject: maths
requests.customPrompt: Worksheet on adding and subtracting fractions with the same denominator, then with related denominators (halves, quarters, eighths). 12 questions, getting harder, including two short word problems.
checks: Fractions are typeset as stacked fractions, not 1/2 text.
Difficulty suits a Year 5 student.

requests.subject: maths
requests.customPrompt: Diagnostic test on area and perimeter of rectangles, triangles and composite shapes made of rectangles. About 10 questions, most with a labelled diagram.
checks: Each diagram's labelled lengths match the question and the worked answer.
Diagrams are legible in black and white.

requests.subject: maths
requests.customPrompt: Worksheet on angles formed by parallel lines and a transversal: corresponding, alternate and co-interior angles. 10 questions, each with a diagram, asking students to find a marked angle and give a reason.
checks: The angle asked for is marked on the diagram.
Worked answers name the correct angle relationship.

requests.subject: maths
requests.customPrompt: Topic booklet on Pythagoras' theorem: finding the hypotenuse, finding a shorter side, and simple word problems (ladders, diagonals). Three sub-topics with practice questions, then an end-of-topic quiz.
checks: Right-angle markers and side labels on every triangle.
Surds or rounding are stated consistently in answers.

requests.subject: maths
requests.customPrompt: Mixed review covering solving linear equations, simplifying ratios, and percentage increase and decrease. 15 questions.
checks: All three topics are covered in roughly equal measure.

requests.subject: maths
requests.customPrompt: Practice paper on right-angled trigonometry: finding sides and angles with sin, cos and tan, plus angles of elevation and depression. 45 minutes.
checks: Triangles show which angle and sides are given.
Answers are rounded as the question asks.

requests.subject: maths
requests.customPrompt: Worksheet on linear graphs: gradient and y-intercept, finding the equation of a line from its graph, and sketching lines from y = mx + c. 10 questions with coordinate-plane diagrams.
checks: Graph axes are labelled and the plotted lines match the equations in the answers.

requests.subject: maths
requests.customPrompt: Topic booklet on quadratics: factorising, solving by factorising and by the quadratic formula, and sketching parabolas with intercepts and turning point. Three sub-topics and an end-of-topic quiz.
checks: Parabola sketches match the stated intercepts and turning point.
Quadratic formula working is correct.

requests.subject: maths
requests.customPrompt: Practice paper on probability: two-way tables, Venn diagrams with set notation (union, intersection, complement), and tree diagrams for two-step experiments. 45 minutes.
checks: Set symbols (∪, ∩, ξ, complement) render correctly in questions and diagrams; no ξ where x is meant.
Venn diagram region counts add up and match the answers.

requests.subject: maths
requests.customPrompt: Study guide on statistics: five-number summary, box plots, comparing data sets, and reading histograms. Four sections with worked examples.
checks: Box plots and histograms match the data in the worked examples.

requests.subject: english
requests.customPrompt: Worksheet on similes, metaphors and personification, built around a short poem suitable for Year 5. Students identify each technique and explain its effect in a sentence.
checks: The poem is real, attributed, and suitable for Year 5.
Questions refer to lines that actually appear in the poem.

requests.subject: english
requests.customPrompt: Reading comprehension diagnostic with one prose extract: literal, inferential and vocabulary-in-context questions. About 10 questions.
checks: Answers can be found in or inferred from the extract.
Question types cover literal, inferential and vocabulary.

requests.subject: english
requests.customPrompt: Annotation task on a narrative poem suitable for Year 7, focusing on imagery, sound devices and structure.
checks: The full poem text is printed with line numbers and correct attribution.
Model annotations quote the poem accurately.

requests.subject: english
requests.customPrompt: Topic booklet on persuasive writing: persuasive techniques, structuring an argument, and writing a persuasive speech. Three sub-topics with a stimulus to analyse and an end-of-topic quiz.
checks: Each stimulus is near the questions that use it.
Sections open with clear student instructions.

requests.subject: english
requests.customPrompt: Reading practice paper with one prose fiction extract and one poem, short-answer analysis questions on each, and one extended response comparing them. 60 minutes.
checks: Both texts are real and attributed, and the extract matches its stated source.
The marking guide gives criteria, not only a model answer.

requests.subject: english
requests.customPrompt: Practice paper using an extract from Katherine Mansfield's short story "The Garden Party" (from the collection The Garden Party and Other Stories). Short-answer analysis questions and one extended response on class and perspective. 60 minutes.
checks: The extract is really from "The Garden Party" itself, not another story in the collection (RES-101).
The printed title matches the story extracted.

requests.subject: english
requests.customPrompt: Essay scaffold for an analytical essay on how Shelley's "Ozymandias" presents power and time. Thesis, body paragraph plans with evidence, and a conclusion.
checks: Quotations match the poem's actual text.
The scaffold guides an analytical essay, with a clear thesis.

requests.subject: english
requests.customPrompt: Worksheet analysing a visual text (a poster, painting or photograph): composition, salience, vectors, colour and how they create meaning. About 8 questions.
checks: An image is actually printed and the questions match what is visible in it.
Image is attributed.

requests.subject: english
requests.customPrompt: Study guide on writing a short narrative under exam conditions: planning, building character and setting, structure and a satisfying ending. Four sections.
checks: Narrative writing is not taught with analytical-essay structures (no thesis or TETAL paragraphs).

requests.subject: english
requests.customPrompt: Mixed review covering punctuation (apostrophes, commas, direct speech), sentence types, and a short comprehension passage. 15 questions.
checks: Grammar answers are correct and unambiguous.
